answers.core: This improves base culling behavior of Godot, as the default AABB right now is usually not desired for billboarded sprites.
answers.workaround: A custom AABB or cull margin can be set through code based on the size of the sprite or text, but it is extra work for something that seems like a rendering bug, and you would have to remember to do this for every node that could use a sprite.

title: Give billboarded Sprite3D and Label3D nodes a larger AABB
